REC-001.summaryText: 8-week transvaginal ultrasound confirmed intrauterine pregnancy with active fetal cardiac activity (162 bpm). EDD calculated as Nov 20, 2026 based on CRL 18.4mm.
REC-001.fullContent:
CLINICAL NOTE - INITIAL OB VISIT
Date: April 10, 2026
Patient: Sarah Jenkins (31yo G2 P1001)

CHIEF COMPLAINT: Confirmation of pregnancy, positive home pregnancy test.
PAST OBSTETRIC HISTORY: G1 ended in full term spontaneous vaginal delivery in 2021 (3.4kg, no maternal complications).

ULTRASOUND FINDINGS:
Transvaginal scan performed. Single live intrauterine pregnancy demonstrated. Fetal heart rate measured at 162 bpm. Crown-rump length (CRL) measures 18.4 mm, corresponding to 8 weeks 2 days gestation. No subchorionic hematoma identified.

ASSESSMENT & PLAN:
1. Intrauterine pregnancy at 8w2d, concordant with last menstrual period.
2. Routine prenatal vitamins prescribed.
3. Lab panel ordered: CBC, Type & Screen, Rubella, Hepatitis B, HIV, Syphilis, Pap smear.
4. Scheduled for 12-week Nuchal Translucency screening.

REC-004.fullContent:
LABORATORY REPORT - 3-HOUR ORAL GLUCOSE TOLERANCE TEST
Date: August 26, 2026

RESULTS:
- Fasting Glucose: 92 mg/dL (Normal < 95)
- 1-Hour Glucose: 188 mg/dL (Elevated > 180)
- 2-Hour Glucose: 162 mg/dL (Elevated > 155)
- 3-Hour Glucose: 138 mg/dL (Normal < 140)

INTERPRETATION NOTE (LAB): Two elevated values meet diagnostic criteria for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDMA1).

COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT:
- Hemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL
- Hematocrit: 33.8%
- Platelets: 215,000 /uL

REC-006.fullContent:
OBSTETRIC PROGRESS NOTE
Date: September 12, 2026
Gestational Age: 30 weeks 3 days

VITAL SIGNS:
BP: 132/84 mmHg | HR: 78 | Weight: 161 lbs (Total gain: 13 lbs) | Fundal Height: 30 cm | FHR: 144 bpm, regular rhythm.

PHYSICAL EXAM:
Trace bilateral lower extremity edema. No facial edema. Deep tendon reflexes 2+ bilaterally, no clonus.

ASSESSMENT:
1. 30w3d gestation, GDMA1 well-controlled on diet.
2. Borderline BP elevation (132/84). Patient instructed on preeclampsia warning signs (headache, visual changes, RUQ pain).
3. Tdap vaccine administered today.
4. Ordered 32-week growth ultrasound and MFM consult.
